name: Staff of Healing
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 197, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 494
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 197, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 494
Aura moderate conjuration CL 8th
Slot none; Price 29,600 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This white ash staff is decorated with inlaid silver runes. It allows use of the following spells:
Cure serious wounds (1 charge)
Lesser restoration (1 charge)
Remove blindness/deafness (2 charges)
Remove disease (3 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, cure serious wounds, lesser restoration, remove blindness/deafness, remove disease; Cost 14,800 gp
